product.name: Private Credit Fund Management
product.description: Manages on-chain private credit funds providing short-term credit to creditworthy SMEs in emerging markets through blockchain-based mechanisms.

product.name: Connect Wallet Service
product.description: Enables users to connect their external crypto wallets to the Credbull platform for interaction with services.

product.name: Account Service
product.description: Provides user account creation and management to enable participation in loan agreements on the platform.

product.name: Loan Agreement Service
product.description: Allows users to enter into loan agreements with Credbull through the platform, specifying loan terms and managing lending transactions.

product.name: Referral Service
product.description: Enables users who have entered into loan agreements to share unique referral links to invite others to the platform.

product.name: Content Access Service
product.description: Provides users with access to platform content and information through the website without requiring an account.
